title: PR watch
description: Why a pull request is still red, and who clears it. The red and never-ran lanes are listed first with an owner each, because a check that FAILED and a check that never started are different facts and one red dot for both spends a reader's attention on nothing. No fold reads a code host, so the lanes are the crewmate's own last reading of the board and the page marks them as written rather than folded; everything beside them -- the items, their PR numbers, what is waiting on a human -- comes from the work and approvals folds.
